audited_hosted_failure.diagnosis: The shared authored helper held all helper invocations, including master-reference metadata, before the actual transfer could produce its receipt. The actual transfer-specific lifetime was never reached.

implementation: Metadata/helper verbs exec the actual helper with unchanged original argv and inherited stdin; the wrapper does not consume or rewrite JSON requests.

Only original --turtlegit-transfer-notifications/--turtlegit-source-fetch arguments select transfer holding. The actual helper runs first with original stdout/stderr and its real exit code preserved in an independent receipt.

Post-helper hold publishes atomic live producer-shell/child PID receipts, original NUL argv and real transfer exit0. INT/TERM cancellation drains and reaps the hold child and its current sleep before the producer exits with actual cancellation status; no success-code normalization.

Lifecycle controls retain captured backend, typed reference/error/finish rows, exact source refspec append order and duplicates, notification availability, cancelled/retired generation ownership and no late actions.
Already accepted tracking refs remain advanced after cancellation/retirement; local HEAD/index/worktree remain unchanged, with only exact accepted source refspec appends allowed in config.
Standalone selected-library sourceFetch preserves original raw topic branch/flags/exit, first-versus-later loaded refspec behavior, tracking-destination omission and CLI presentation separation.

Both scoped drivers collect independent failures only after an explicit native drained cleanup receipt. Missing cleanup/timeout or any necessary external helper cleanup stops continuation; original diagnostics and per-case statuses remain recorded. Exact private wrapper and atomic PID/argv receipt constrain fallback child cleanup.

earlier_unaffected_checks_not_repeated.qualification: Those earlier bounded passes do not claim current-source complete hosted acceptance.

validation.core: No additional Core tests or app build performed in this consumer subtask; the parent owns its affected production Core/shared Debug checkpoint.

ownership.private_contexts: Each driver uses TemporaryDirectory with private repositories, HOME/CF defaults/config/temp, isolated pasteboards and transparent offscreen windows. All six contexts exited with verified native cleanup and no required fallback helper termination.

limits: No complete corrected-source hosted CI pass.
No physical Finder, public network/authentication, signed deployment, minimum-macOS/Intel or full visual/VoiceOver acceptance.
These are bounded producer/consumer ownership checks, not complete Synchronization/Fetch dialog parity.
No installation, binary publication or App Store submission.
